themes.description: Users are experiencing a significant delay in resolving their issues due to unresponsive customer service. Several customers have reported waiting for extended periods (up to 20 days) for their issues to be addressed, with some being disconnected from customer support team or receiving generic responses without a call back.
themes.business_impact: Delayed resolution of customer issues may lead to loss of customer trust, revenue, and market share due to poor customer experience.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient staffing, inadequate training, or inefficient processes within the customer service team may be contributing to the unresponsiveness.
themes.action_plan:
• Investigate and address staffing and training gaps, optimize customer service process to improve response times, and implement a callback system to ensure timely follow-up with customers.
• Develop a customer service escalation process to handle complex issues.
• Establish clear metrics and goals for customer service team performance to ensure accountability.

themes.description: Users have experienced difficulties in withdrawing or getting refunds for their fixed deposits (FDs), with some reporting complete losses of their funds.
themes.business_impact: Potential financial losses for users, damage to brand reputation, and long-term loss of customer trust.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Technical issues within the application or with the bank's API, coupled with inadequate customer support.
themes.action_plan: • Investigate technical issues and partner with the bank to ensure seamless FD withdrawals/refunds; provide clear communication and timely resolution to customer support queries; implement a robust refund mechanism to prevent losses.
